text: Implemented the fold-safe FittedLatentEncoder over explicit ObservationPattern values with fixed-decoder quadratic, Huber, logistic, and categorical losses; ridge/L1 row penalties; typed domain, support, censoring, and solver failures; decoded predictions; objective, prox-gradient residual, support, achievement, and uniqueness evidence. Focused encoder suites pass 9/9 on JVM and 9/9 on Scala.js. Full multivarJVM/test plus multivarJS/test completed with exit 0 at 410 tests per platform. git diff --check is clean and mote doctor reports a clean store.
